relations.quote: Gaussian resampling expresses each source [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) through a power-of-two tensor transform, meaning a transform over several axes at once in which each axis length is a power of two.

Gaussian resampling is applied to the [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) of the two integers' digit coefficients, so the Fourier transforms it replaces are those of that convolution.
